messages.author: 12f269733c6eb9a2
messages.subject: Re: Stratification Help
parts:
Justus:

I wish I could show you the 'stratification command' in Distance.
Unfortunately there is no such thing for the multilayer survey that you
have carried out.

I suggest you poke around within the archives of this list for
inspiration. You will need to alter your problem in some manner
(combine 2 seasons by 2 sites into 4 season-site strata; invoke
something as a covariate for your detection function modelling perhaps)
to be able to make progress. We can't offer usable advice beyond this.
Have a look at an extensive comment Jeff Laake provided on this subject
back in 2008
https://www.jiscmail.ac.uk/cgi-bin/webadmin?A2=ind0805&L=DISTANCE-SAMPLING&P=R807&1=DISTANCE-SAMPLING&9=A&J=on&d=No+Match%3BMatch%3BMatches&z=4.
Or put in your own search term in the archive search engine
(https://www.jiscmail.ac.uk/cgi-bin/webadmin?A0=DISTANCE-SAMPLING)

See if that doesn't get you started on your search.
